label: Big Band Jazz / Swing / Musical Theatre

cards.mood: The piece opens with a mischievous and theatrical energy, establishing a playful yet eerie narrative tone.
cards.palette: A driving upright bass provides the harmonic and rhythmic foundation throughout the entire track, playing a walking bass line that anchors the swing feel.
